body:
S5 is done by the cheap option; no SKETCH is needed. Under the main merge-lease I ran `git repack -d` on the primary checkout. It took 825 s and brought loose objects from 128,766 down to 7,170. Re-measured cold seat-clone creation: p95 3.3 s, was 35.7 s; warm p95 is 1.2 s. That is under 20 s, so there is no host clone pool.
READY: #2847 at 3ad650721c (Refs TASK-2053). It adds the `aida doctor` `loose-objects` category: a finding when main's loose count is over `[doctor.loose_objects] max` (default 20000), with the repack as the remedy. Note: main already has gc.auto=500, yet 128k loose objects built up anyway.
Merge order: #2839 carries the completing (TASK-2053) trailer, so #2847 should land before it. If you would rather it be the other way round, tell me and I'll move the trailer.
Stack status:
- #2833 is READY at 367532bb54.
- #2839 has your rulings applied at 9985d93bf2.
subject: READY: #2847 (S5 = repack + doctor check; cold p95 35.7s -> 3.3s)
